Scripture mosaic

Today's reflection.
Tomorrow's picture.

Collect pieces as you write reflections and memorize Scripture. Each small step reveals a little more of the picture.

  1. One piece for a reflectionRead the verse and write what's on your heart today.
  2. Another piece for memorizationComplete memorization to collect one more piece that day.
  3. Finish the picture at your own paceYour progress adds up. Taking a day off won't send you back to the start.

Scripture mosaics are available on Android first. An iOS update is planned.

A daily rhythm of reflection

Make room for Scripture in your day

  • Read and remember

    Read today's illustrated verse, then memorize it with a three-step fill-in-the-blank exercise. Revisit the verses you've learned in your calendar.

  • Write what's on your heart

    Choose words that resonate, record your feelings, and reflect. Keep your gratitude and prayer requests in your own devotional journal.

  • Look back on your journey

    See your reflections, mood journal, and reflection streaks in your calendar and statistics. Android also offers church calendars and seasons suited to your church, with an iOS update planned.

  • Find a rhythm that fits

    Set a Scripture reminder for a time that works for you, and see the day's verse on your home screen widget. Read comfortably before bed with dark mode.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Is BibleOn free?

BibleOn is free to download and use, with ads and optional support. Saving an original-resolution verse image on Android may require watching an ad.

Which Bible translation does the app use?

BibleOn offers Korean and English Scripture and illustrations, following your device's language. Korean Scripture uses 개역개정.

Is BibleOn available on iPhone?

Yes. BibleOn is available on Google Play and the App Store. The previews on this page show Android. Scripture mosaics, the saved gallery, and church calendars are planned for an iOS update.

Can I keep prayer notes in the app?

You can write prayer requests and gratitude in BibleOn's reflection journal. The prayer app link in Android settings opens a separate app; it is not a built-in BibleOn feature.

How does verse memorization work?

Memorize today's verse in three steps by filling in the blanks. Review learned verses in your calendar. On Android, completing memorization also earns a mosaic piece for that day.

Do I need an unbroken streak to finish a mosaic?

No. You earn one piece for saving a written reflection and another for first completing memorization that day. Repeated saves or reviews on the same day do not earn extra pieces. Your progress stays even if you skip a day. Available on Android first, with an iOS update planned.

What appears in the saved gallery?

The calendar gallery shows BibleOn images saved on your Android device. It does not automatically archive every verse you read or back up images to the cloud. An iOS update is planned.

How are my entries protected?

Your reflections and prayer entries are handled with care under our Privacy Policy (Korean).
